candidates.reason: Unit tests for scrapy.utils.response, the module that owns open_in_browser(). The file imports open_in_browser and already asserts the behavior this change alters: test_open_in_browser and test_open_in_browser_raises_for_unsupported_response_type expect TypeError for a plain Response (binary body), while test_open_in_browser_text_response_uses_txt_extension pins the .txt suffix for text responses. New tests for Content-Type-driven suffixes (image/png, application/pdf, missing Content-Type) belong here as well.

TestViewCommand drives `scrapy view`, which delegates to open_in_browser() and currently rejects non-text responses via the TextResponse guard in scrapy/commands/view.py; test_non_text_response asserts the error message "Cannot view a non-text response." for the mock server PNG (served as image/png). If the command now opens non-text responses, this test must change to assert the browser receives a file:// URL, so it is a candidate for the change's verification.
